card.name: Start of unusual drug names and biologic tags
card.fires_on: The first piece of an uncommon proper name or a biologic drug's four-letter suffix, such as Sk in Skidi, j in enfortumab vedotin-ejfv, or -b in epcoritamab-bysp. It fires where the next piece is an unusual letter sequence.

modes.label: Rare proper names
modes.description: Opening piece of a less common place or people name that continues in an unexpected way.
modes.example: the Chaui, Kitkehakhi, Pitahawirata, and<< Sk>>idi. Historically, the Pawnee

modes.label: Biologic drug suffixes
modes.description: Start of the random four-letter suffix attached to a biologic drug name after a hyphen.
modes.example: Administer KEYTRUDA after enfortumab vedotin-e<<j>>fv when given on the same day.

card.writes: It pushes digit tokens and suppresses code-like word pieces, so it adds little beyond a vague sense of what comes next.
card.plain: It lights up at the start of an unfamiliar name, such as the odd letter tag at the end of a biologic drug name.
